description: The USD-not-token gate regex produces false-negatives that silently DROP real, payable bounties. run.sh:105 drops a bounty if the lowercased title+body+description matches `\bearn [a-z]{2,5}\b|\b\d+\s*(rtc|\$[a-z]{2,6}|tokens?)\b|token.?farm|social mining|clanker|/tip`. Two sub-patterns are over-broad on ordinary English/engineering text: (1) `\bearn [a-z]{2,5}\b` matches legitimate phrases like 'earn cash', 'earn money', 'earn usd', 'earn fast' — a real USD bounty whose description says 'earn money fixing this' is dropped. (2) `\b\d+\s*tokens?\b` matches commonplace software language: 'fix 3 tokens not refreshing', 'expose 2 tokens', JWT/OAuth/API/CSS-design tokens. Auth/ORM/frontend bounties (the exact high-value targets in bounties.json: drizzle, zod, keystatic) routinely say 'N tokens' and would be classified as token-farms and dropped. Dropping real bounties directly kills earnings — the gate must verify the actual reward currency via the algora-pbc comment / Algora API, not infer 'token' from incidental keywords.
